raw:
I spread 100 experiments evenly: 20 for each of the five hyperparameters being edited. Each edit starts from a base configuration (alpha 3.59e-05, batch 25, depth 2, learning rate 0.00167, width 101). In each run I move other hyperparameters to their low or high band, so the same edit can be compared under contrasting conditions. The interactions this targets:
- learning rate × batch size
- learning rate × depth
- width × depth
- the effect of strong L2 penalty (alpha)

I entered the top width grid value, shown as 1.02e+03, as 1024.
